restated: Let f(q,r) be defined by the Brouwer recurrence (MISSION section 2), B_c(x)=f(c+x,c)-(c+x) when f(c+x,c)>=c+x (undefined otherwise), and dec(X)={x-1 : x in X, x>=1}. Fix r>=1. Put V''(a)=union over c<r of {B_c(a+r-c)} (defined values only), V'(a)=union over c<r of {B_c(0)-(r-c)-a} intersected with the non-negative integers, and m_r = 1 + max of all defined B_c(x), c<r. Define H_0=V'(0), k_a = smallest non-negative integer not in V''(a) u H_a, H_{a+1}=dec(H_a) u {k_a-1}, stopping when k_a=0. Then k_a = B_r(a) for every a up to and including the first a with k_a=0 (and for all a if there is none), H_a is contained in [0,m_r-1], k_a<=m_r, and m_r<=r+1. This is an exact reformulation; it claims no bound on preperiods.
ledger_statement: MERGED-TRAIL MACHINE (exact reformulation of Zeilberger's Fundamental Recurrence; no bound claimed). For every r>=1, with dec(X)={x-1: x in X, x>=1}, the row-r loser sequence L_a=B_r(a) is generated by k_a = mex_{>=0}(V''(a) u H_a), H_{a+1} = dec(H_a) u {k_a-1}, H_0 = V'(0), k_a=0 terminating, where V''(a)=u_{c<r}{B_c(a+r-c)} (defined values only) and V'(a)=u_{c<r}{B_c(0)-(r-c)-a} n Z>=0. Moreover H_a subset [0,m_r-1] and k_a<=m_r<=r+1, m_r=1+max defined B_c, so the state (a mod q_r; H_a) ranges over at most q_r*2^{m_r} values. Row 0 is excluded (f(q,0)=q+1).
